LanguageData.RP_PrepHeaderTip: Inmates within five days of release or of a hearing. For each the warden can fund lodging, arrange a job interview on a vocational certificate, or leave them to what they have. Lodging is paid when they leave, if the money is there; a promise nobody funds does nothing. After they leave they are reviewed once a day, and the outcome (stayed out or arrested again) is counted only when it is seen.
